snippet.title: The Colored Moth - Trailer
snippet.description:
It is a narrative game about being different from everyone else and the need to hide your true identity. The game is inspired by true events (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P2rHGg2akpw).

Game Link: https://amidos2006.itch.io/the-colored-moth

Credits:
Game and Video: Ahmed Khalifa
Script Editing: Christopher Michaels
Music: Kevin Macleod (Walking Along, A Very Brady Special, Ghost Story, Laser Groove, and Dream Catcher)
